title: Intermittent Redis latency in auth-service
summary: Redis cache miss rate reached 18% during peak morning login window. Resolved after cache eviction policy tuned.

title: order-service Outage: Upstream Timeout Configuration Failure in v2.4.1
summary: order-service is in CRITICAL status with a 94.5% error rate, open circuit breaker, and 4800ms p95 latency. Root cause traced to deployment v2.4.1 (commit c7a8b9f), which lowered the inventory-service call timeout from 30000ms to 3000ms and disabled retries (max_retries: 0). This causes downstream timeouts on checkout requests and a large order queue backlog (>14,500 pending).

title: Order Service Failures due to Upstream Timeout Configuration Mismatch
summary: order-service requests are failing due to an upstream timeout mismatch introduced in deployment v2.4.1 (timeout reduced to 3000ms while inventory-service p95 latency is ~3200ms). Note: inventory-service itself is healthy and functioning normally; the issue is entirely caused by order-service's overly aggressive timeout configuration.

title: Order Service Outage: Upstream Inventory Timeout & Queue Backlog (v2.4.1)
summary: order-service is failing with 94.5% error rate and an open circuit breaker due to the v2.4.1 deployment lowering the inventory-service timeout threshold from 30000ms to 3000ms (max_retries: 0). Upstream calls to inventory-service exceed 3000ms, causing 504 Gateway Timeouts, an order queue backlog exceeding 14,000 orders, and 503 service unavailability.
